The '''2022 Copa Sudamericana final''' was the final match which decided the winner of the [[2022 Copa Sudamericana]]. This was the 21st edition of the [[Copa Sudamericana]], the second-tier South American continental club [[Association football|football]] tournament organized by [[CONMEBOL]].

The match was played on 1 October 2022 between Brazilian club [[São Paulo FC|São Paulo]] and Ecuadorian club [[C.S.D. Independiente del Valle|Independiente del Valle]], and it was originally scheduled to be played at [[Estádio Nacional Mané Garrincha]] in [[Brasília]], Brazil;<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.lance.com.br/futebol-nacional/conmebol-define-que-estadio-mane-garrincha-sera-palco-final-sul-americana-2022.html|title=Conmebol define que Estádio Mané Garrincha será palco da final da Sul-Americana de 2022|trans-title=CONMEBOL defines that Mané Garrincha Stadium will host the 2022 Copa Sudamericana final|publisher=LANCE!|date=13 May 2021|access-date=27 May 2022|language=pt}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://blogs.correiobraziliense.com.br/dribledecorpo/decisao-da-copa-sul-americana-2022-no-mane-garrincha-ja-tem-data-1o-de-outubro/|title=Decisão da Copa Sul-Americana 2022 no Mané Garrincha já tem data: 1º de outubro|trans-title=2022 Copa Sudamericana decision at Mané Garrincha already has a date: October 1|publisher=Correio Braziliense|date=17 August 2021|access-date=27 May 2022|language=pt}}</ref> however, on 23 June 2022 CONMEBOL announced that a change of venue was requested by the [[Brazilian Football Confederation]] due to the [[2022 Brazilian general election]] taking place one day after the date of the match. Following consultations between the members of CONMEBOL's Council, [[Estadio Mario Alberto Kempes]] in [[Córdoba, Argentina]], which previously hosted the [[2020 Copa Sudamericana final|final match]] of the [[2020 Copa Sudamericana]], was selected as the new venue for the match.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/cordoba-sera-una-fiesta-con-la-final-de-la-conmebol-sudamericana-2022/|title=Córdoba será una fiesta con la Final de la CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2022|trans-title=Córdoba will be a party with the 2022 CONMEBOL Sudamericana final|publisher=CONMEBOL|language=es|date=23 June 2022|access-date=23 June 2022}}</ref>

Independiente del Valle defeated São Paulo by a 2–0 score in the final to win their second title in the tournament. As winners of the 2022 Copa Sudamericana, they earned the right to play against the winners of the [[2022 Copa Libertadores]] in the [[2023 Recopa Sudamericana]]. They also automatically qualified for the [[2023 Copa Libertadores]] group stage.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://conmebolsudamericana.com/cards/NewsReaderWeb/independiente-del-valle-es-el-campeon-de-la-conmebol-sudamericana |title=¡Independiente del Valle es el campeón de la CONMEBOL Sudamericana! |publisher=CONMEBOL Sudamericana |language=es |date=1 October 2022}}</ref>
